Compare two screening conditions of a chemical genomics screen and perform GSEA

Source: R/plot-chemical_genomics.R
analyze_cgs_conditions.Rd

Compares the response to each library drug between two conditions, each a cell line at one co-treatment concentration (0 for the drug alone), and runs GSEA over the drug classes (drug_moa). The conditions may use different cell lines and different co-treatment concentrations, for example a resistant line kept in the anchor drug against its parental line in standard medium. The difference is condition1 minus condition2.

Usage

analyze_cgs_conditions(
  dt_metrics,
  condition1,
  condition2,
  metrics = "x_mean",
  normalization_type = "RV"
)

Arguments

dt_metrics

A data.table of combination metrics, as for analyze_cgs, with cotrt_value.

condition1, condition2

Named lists with cell_line (a value of CellLineName) and cotrt_value (a co-treatment concentration of that cell line, 0 for the drug alone).

metrics

A character vector of metrics to compare: "x_mean", "x_AOC_range", "xc50", "ec50", "x_max". xc50 is compared on the log10 scale.

normalization_type

A string, "RV" or "GR".

Value

A list of one element, named "<condition1> vs. <condition2>", with fgsea, metrics_diff and moa_list as returned by analyze_cgs, so plot_cgs_ranking can draw it.

Examples

dt_metrics <- qs2::qs_read(system.file("testdata/cgs_data.qs2", package = "gDRplots"))
analyze_cgs_conditions(dt_metrics,
                       condition1 = list(cell_line = "CellLineName_1", cotrt_value = 1),
                       condition2 = list(cell_line = "CellLineName_2", cotrt_value = 0))
#> $`CellLineName_1 (co-treatment 1) vs. CellLineName_2 (single agent)`
#> $`CellLineName_1 (co-treatment 1) vs. CellLineName_2 (single agent)`$fgsea
#> $`CellLineName_1 (co-treatment 1) vs. CellLineName_2 (single agent)`$fgsea$x_mean
